rows.resolution_note: p003 sentences 47-49 are one description of the dataset: a publicly available sepsis GWAS in the UK Biobank cohort with 11,643 cases and 474,841 controls (sentence 48), defined by ICD-10 codes A02, A39, A40, A41 and attributed to reference 15, Hamilton et al. 2023, DOI 10.1371/journal.pmed.1004174 (sentence 49). The passage names one specific GWAS; no outcome row has that citation, those counts or that phenotype.
rows.quote: The primary discovery analysis used the UK Biobank cohort, which included 11,643 individuals with sepsis and 474,841 controls of European ancestry.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: the UK Biobank cohort, which included 11,643 individuals with sepsis and 474,841 controls of European ancestry
